notes: The italicized *shall he … clothe* is an added resumption under rule 103, ἀμφιέννυσιν being spent on the protasis; reading it as a discontinuous second realization under rule 15 remains defensible and is recorded in the unit's note.
ὀλιγόπιστοι heads on the compound's core *faith* (rule 66), with the supplied address word *O ye* riding along under rule 89's anarthrous arm.
